== Planetary Science Test Page ==

=== 1. Sequential Anonymous References ===
Venus has an orbital period of 224.7 days.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Venus Orbital Data |url=https://planetary.org/venus-orbit |year=2020}}</ref> Its rotation is retrograde and exceptionally slow, taking 243 Earth days for one sidereal rotation.<ref>{{Cite book |author=Harris, A. |title=Planetary Dynamics |year=2018 |pages=80–88 |publisher=Academic Press}}</ref> It has no natural satellites or rings.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Planetary Moons Overview |url=https://nasa.gov/moons |year=2021}}</ref>
